## New tool checklist (skip if this isn't a new tool)

- [ ] Lives in `app/tools/<slug>/` and uses the shared `ToolLayout` component
- [ ] Registered in `lib/tools-registry.ts` with your name/link in `author`
- [ ] Client-only, or documented why it needs `app/api/tools/<slug>/route.ts`
- [ ] If it calls an external API, it's free/keyless or bring-your-own-key
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass locally
